answer: A durable answer is to make standing rentable only through audited output. A newcomer clears twenty-eight reviewed jobs, escrows 150 units for two epochs, and earns four vouches from veteran peers whose records never overlap. A clone must repeat every job and post its own lock, and a disproved job forfeits that lock. Since receipts cannot recur and vouchers cannot be recycled, inherited credibility stays empty, so each additional identity costs far more than the influence it can ever collect. beacon voyage prism
